integrity: Finite recursive types are checked with two separate implementations and a direct unreduced enumeration for n<=4; all verification sources and output are provided. Infinite equivalence is based on a mathematical strategy, not extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Only unlabeled undirected 1-subdivisions of complete graphs, pure first-order adjacency with equality, ranks one to five. Finite exact type computations plus an independent infinite-tail game proof; historical priority is not exhaustively established; independent mathematical audit is not performed.
title: Sharp first-order visibility thresholds through five rounds for complete-graph incidence graphs
